task_title: Expose AI runner world feature flags

plan_review.notes: Revised plan adds CLI parse/help/forwarding, explicit selected-vs-applied flag snapshots, floor/target applicability metadata, enabled and independence-matrix coverage, and uses ScenarioInitializationOptions as the shared seam. Reuses the existing Apply staged + restart button, with flag-specific stale status and labeling, rather than adding a competing restart mechanism.

independent_grade.notes: The implementation expertly introduces the attackWaves and floor1Spawners feature flags, cleanly threading them through the headless CLI and lab UI. It handles the reload-required semantics gracefully, appropriately applies targets, and correctly centralizes defaults in the feature flag registry instead of the CLI layer. Test coverage is robust across unit and headless integration layers, and the code maintains high clarity and strict adherence to architectural policies.
